title: Bias-Aware BiLSTM Toxicity Ensemble
summary: The solution lowercases comments, tokenizes words and punctuation, truncates to 220 tokens, and builds a training-only vocabulary of up to 200,000 tokens with minimum frequency two. A randomly initialized 200-dimensional embedding feeds two bidirectional LSTMs. Masked mean and max pooling are concatenated, passed through two residual ReLU linear layers, and produce a toxicity logit plus auxiliary identity logits. The main binary cross-entropy loss uses bias-aware row weights that emphasize subgroup and subgroup/label-mismatch cases; masked auxiliary BCE over identity labels is added equally. Three models with different seeds, LSTM widths, and embedding dropout are trained for four epochs using length-bucketed shuffled batches, Adam, cosine-decayed learning rate, mixed precision, and gradient clipping. Validation predictions are collected from epochs one onward and ensemble-averaged as probabilities. Inference uses bucketed padded batches and sigmoid-transformed toxicity logits.
